records.title: Upwork proposal reasoning pipeline
records.rule: Run the required stages in order; a failed fit, evidence, claim, or integrity gate stops drafting or narrows the claim.
decision_logic: Advance sequentially through the named stages.
Stop or qualify when a gate fails.
Record outcome for the learning loop.
guardrails: No templates as a substitute for reasoning.
No invented platform evidence or client intent.

source_support.paraphrased_support_note: Flynn V1 uses staged diagnosis and rewrite logic.
Garner separates purpose, reader analysis, planning, drafting, and judgment.

derivation.synthesis_or_extension_note: The workflow is an AI-agent extension of the required design and supplied communication frameworks.
derivation.confidence_rationale: Operational rule synthesized or extended from the cited supplied foundations.

source_limitation.what_was_preserved: All capability names and workflow requirements explicitly listed in the user design brief were implemented.
source_limitation.what_was_not_claimed: No original Upwork record wording, current platform algorithm, best-time rule, Boost advantage, or review-based conversion claim was inferred.
